# ============================================================================
# BRAND SUMMARY
# ============================================================================
Brillarix is an AI-native product studio that transforms ideas into high-performance web applications. We specialize in blending low-code platforms (like Bubble.io) with custom full-stack development to create scalable, secure, and efficient digital solutions. Our AI-driven team designs and builds at startup speed, delivering 25-50% faster development cycles through intelligent automation, rapid prototyping, and hybrid code/no-code approaches.

Tagline: "Powering Digital Innovation with Low-Code & Custom Solutions"
Mission: Building scalable web products, from MVP to full-stack platforms, using AI-driven workflows to help modern founders launch and scale faster.
